layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Piscivore diet symbolism
features: A stylized, cartoonish whole silver fish made of smooth clay
The fish body is a soft metallic-grey clay with a large, friendly round white eye and a single cartoon scale pattern
Smooth, rounded fins and tail to maintain a toy-like, friendly aesthetic
Soft studio lighting with gentle highlights
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered shot of a clay fish sitting on a simple clay surface. The background is a soft, neutral out-of-focus color. The image is designed as a clear icon or symbol to indicate a fish-eating diet for a children's matching game. No text.
